ينتقيان (form VIII)
# يَنْتَقِيَانِ (yantaqiyāni) /jan.ta.qi.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
# يُنْتَقَيَانِ (yuntaqayāni) /jun.ta.qa.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
